Test unnesting of tokens

```{r}
tar_load(starts_with("df"))
df_raw          <- open_dataset(df_raw)
df_clean        <- open_dataset(df_clean)
```

```{r}
tar_load(matches("tokens_[^v]"))
tokens_raw      <- open_dataset(tokens_raw)
tokens_clean    <- open_dataset(tokens_clean)
tokens_bi_raw   <- open_dataset(tokens_bi_raw)
tokens_bi_clean <- open_dataset(tokens_bi_clean)
```


```{r}
list_df_tokens <- list(
  "df_raw" = df_raw,
  "df_clean" = df_clean,
  "tokens_raw" = tokens_raw,
  "tokens_clean" = tokens_clean,
  "tokens_bi_raw" = tokens_bi_raw,
  "tokens_bi_clean" = tokens_bi_clean
)

list_df_tokens |> map(\(x) dim(x))
```

```{r}
anti_join(df_clean, df_raw, join_by(season, episode, line)) |> collect()
anti_join(df_clean, df_raw, join_by(transcript), copy = TRUE) |> collect()
```

```{r}
check_line_mismatch <- function(x, y, s, e, offset = FALSE) {
  
  if (offset == TRUE) {
    a <- x + 1
    b <- y + 1
  } else {
    a <- x
    b <- y
  }
  
  df_raw |>
    select(season, episode, line, type, speaker, transcript) |> 
    filter(season == s, episode == e, line >= x, line <= y) |>
    collect() |>
    gt() |> print()
  
  df_clean |>
    select(season, episode, line, type, speaker, transcript) |> 
    filter(season == s, episode == e, line >= a, line <= b) |>
    collect() |> 
    gt() |> print()
  
}

check_line_mismatch(376, 379, 8, 15)

```

df_raw |>

  collect()
